title: Dialogue Manager
cue: branching dialogue from text files, with a balloon
summary: Branching dialogue written as .dialogue text files with characters, choices, conditions, variables and function calls, plus a ready-made dialogue balloon UI.
useWhen: NPCs talk with the player in conversations with branching choices, or the game has quests, shops, or story scenes such as a visual novel's, whose lines depend on game state, need localization, or are more than fit comfortably in GDScript arrays.
avoidWhen: Only a few fixed lines, signs or tooltips; a Label or a short array of strings in GDScript is simpler.
